mapper.select: SELECT community_id AS communityId, community_name AS communityName, community_detailed_address AS address, community_code AS communityCode, community_longitude AS longitude, community_latitude AS latitude FROM community WHERE community_id = #{communityId}

SELECT community_id AS communityId, community_name AS communityName, community_detailed_address AS address, community_code AS communityCode, community_longitude AS longitude, community_latitude AS latitude FROM community WHERE community_longitude IS NOT NULL AND community_latitude IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(community_longitude) != '' AND TRIM(community_latitude) != '' ORDER BY community_sort ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT community_id FROM community WHERE community_longitude IS NOT NULL AND community_latitude IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(community_longitude) != '' AND TRIM(community_latitude) != ''
AND community_id IN
#{cid}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN community_id = #{currentCommunityId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, community_sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND room_status IN ('occupied', 'has_stay')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_device WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND device_status = '1'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_repair_order WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND status = '1'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM complaint_suggest WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND remark IS NULL AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM visitor WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND DATE(visitor_date) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_fee_bill fb INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = fb.room_id WHERE r.community_id = #{communityId} AND fb.bill_status != '3'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_fee_bill fb INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = fb.room_id WHERE r.community_id = #{communityId} AND fb.bill_status = '2'
